retrieved_via: web text rendering; manually transcribed selected zero-based source rows; generated normalized facts
immutable_content_note: Immutable raw content was unavailable; retrieved master rows are not asserted byte-identical to the history-head revision.
limitations: Both records preserve standalone MAGIC ATK and INCREASE_ATK extra roles; amount is the same source value in both cases.
Extras are allowed only after a WEAPON-origin base with hitRate zero; they cannot augment a percentage base or another MAGIC base.
A first hand use consumes its card, learns/retains the miracle and pays MP. A retained use pays MP without consuming the retained ability, and can occur repeatedly in one command.
Every use contributes one pending gift according to the source command processing; MP and retention are paid/learned before target response.
Ordered additions participate in normal element composition and can precede or follow supported ADD_ATTRIBUTE setters.

With MAGICAL57 as the base, each added MAGIC first pays its cost, then resets damage to twice the remaining MP, discarding earlier boosts, before adding its own amount. Final MAGICAL payment empties the remaining MP.
An ordered action representation must retain repeated held uses and the distinction between ordinary boosts before and after an added miracle.
MAGIC_FREE, WIDE_ATK209 and DOUBLE_ATK214 remain completely excluded; no waiver or multiplier role is stripped into this catalog.
These records have no defense role, percentage, disease or harm.
Source prices10/15 are preserved in source-rows.csv even though the runtime type needs only element, amount, MP cost and weight.
The two local indices do not renumber any old miracle or defensive ability indices.
Historical IDs and technical labels are not verified current official IDs or names.
Old acquisition weights are not verified official probabilities; upstream reports distribution uncertainty.
All nineteen earlier catalogs, fingerprints and miracle indices remain unchanged.
